source.interpretation: RANDOM initiation draws mission quantity from IQTY=3 and IQTYD=<POISSON>, then independently draws each start time uniformly within [STIM=8, STIM+IPER=20) when IDISP=RANDOM. Eight deployed aircraft are a capacity control for observed clustered starts; they do not change the specified count or time distributions.

exact_delta: OperationProfile.IDISP changes EQUIDIST to RANDOM; ITYPE=RANDOM, IQTY=3, IQTYD=<POISSON>, STIM=8, IPER=12 and the fixed two-hour mission template remain.
SystemDeployment.QTYPS changes 3 to 8 so random clusters can start without an incidental aircraft shortage in the planned sample.
ProblemDescription.PDESC and Unit.DESCR change only provenance labels; the other 27 tables, 32 replications, seed, zero failure rate and report horizon remain identical.
predeclared_native_acceptance: One immutable guarded session-0 SSH aggregate run with host-wide mutex, GUI PID 13340 identity guard, source/raw SHA-256 seals, four CLI steps and exact row-containing source roundtrip; zero conversion errors and classified warnings.
Require NREP=32 and 72 aligned half-hour system and stock bins. If its native event log exposes only one replication, do not infer the other 31 counts or timelines from averaged reports.

Across directly observable one-replication runs, require nonnegative realized counts, every start in [8,20), distinct printed start times when the count exceeds one, success/completion two hours after each start, no shortage/cancellation/failure/repair/stock demand, and reported aircraft operation exposure equal to twice the realized count.

At least two realized counts and at least one count-three-or-higher run with start gaps unequal to the EQUIDIST layout must be observed. This tests stochastic count and time placement in the finite sample without proving either underlying law.

Retain every count and timestamp with its replication identity. Report count sample mean, sample variance and nominal two-sided 95 percent Student-t half-width on 32 per-run counts, targeting at most one mission. For timing, compute each nonzero-count run's mean start time first, then report the nominal Student-t half-width across those run means using its actual degrees of freedom, targeting at most 1.5 hours. Also report the pooled start mean only as a descriptive event-level value, not as an independent-sample confidence interval.
A separate read-only reviewer replays source delta, raw seals, event identities and timings, statistics and report ledgers without importing author validation.
limits: One <POISSON> quantity parameter, one 12-hour period, one aggregate seed, 32 aggregate replications, eight deployed aircraft and a separate explicit-seed matrix. Zero-count and high-count capacity boundaries are verified only if actually drawn.

The fixed convenience seed set and nominal confidence intervals do not prove the native Poisson or uniform laws or seed independence. GUI visual content and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
